title: project-marker
description: Identity of a project inside its repository (.swissknifeman/project.json), committed with the project. It names the project and where its plans live; it holds no path.

project_id.description: Project id: prj_ and 26 Crockford base32 characters.

plans_store.description: Where the plans of the project live: `legacy` is <project>/plans, `workspace` is the portable workspace. The one switch of the store.
